children: Challenger keeps its bull at Citi despite uncertainty over whether Daiichi Life will further raise its offer for the Australian investment manager. Analyst Nigel Pittaway keeps a buy rating on the stock, telling clients in a note that he is slightly surprised the Japanese insurer responded to the rejection of its initial approach by raising its offer by just 3.4%. "The outcome was surely fairly clear," Pittaway writes. He thinks Daiichi will come back with a more appropriate offer, which he reckons would be about 13.04 Australian dollars a share. Citi has a target price on the stock of A$13.20. Shares are down 1.1% at A$11.815. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
